name: The New Pennsburg Diner

story.heading: A family diner since 1981
paragraphs: The New Pennsburg Diner has been family owned since 1981. The room is built for regulars and for people who just found the lot.
Breakfast runs all day. The half-pound burger is the lunch they still name on the site. Call 215-679-2190 or order online. The family still runs the room.
Call 215-679-2190. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.

experience.heading: How a diner visit should feel.
items: Sit down for breakfast at 2 if that's when you got hungry.
The burger comes with steak fries. Pick coleslaw or guacamole.
Events and a bigger table are possible. Ask when you call.

feature.heading: The half-pound burger is the lunch special that stuck
feature.text: A diner lives on the plate you reorder. Breakfast all day covers the morning people. The burger covers everyone else. Breakfast all day, because the first meal shouldn't expire at 11.
